title: Verify the combined navigation,
notes: paint, spacing and rule-precision repairs on the frozen source tree.
result: The package gate covers the repaired client-document redirects, unfinished resources, references, dates, hidden measurement text, transparent PDF glyphs, intrinsic controls and two-pixel spacing. Existing standalone ESLint compatibility and noninteractive column cases remain in the active backlog.
evidence: `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality lint`, `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality type-check`, `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality build` and `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality test --maxWorkers=1` all exited 0; 113 files and 430 tests passed with coverage. Root `pnpm knip --treat-config-hints-as-errors` and its `--production` variant passed; the two existing production binary warnings remain. Quality-config's full suite passed 36 tests in ten files, with package lint/typecheck and formatting. This is source validation, not npm publication or consumer deployment.
